productName: Signal2Noise — Daily 80/20 Priority Filter & Side-Panel Focus Pill

shortVideo.fullText: Tired of filtering daily priorities without drowning in a bloated task backlog getting locked behind monthly subscriptions and external cloud portals? With Signal2Noise, Hard-Capped 10-Item Capture & 2–4 Priority Lock runs right where you already work. Calm One-Line Priority Pill in Peripheral View and Instant Standup Copy & Plain-Text Download—100% under your own custody. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.

demoVideo.fullText: Need a better way to handle filtering daily priorities without drowning in a bloated task backlog, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch Signal2Noise in action: Prevents task-list inflation by limiting today's list to 10 candidates and forcing you to choose the 2–4 high-leverage signals that actually move the needle. Collapse your side panel down to a quiet, always-visible priority pill so you never lose sight of your #1 task while switching tabs. Plus, copy your completed and active signals as clean plain text or Markdown in one click to paste straight into Slack, notes, or daily standups. No login walls, no gamified streak shaming, and zero usage telemetry. Your daily priorities stay 100% private inside your browser. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
